conventions.quantiles: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; population SD; midrank ties
conventions.displayClustering: middle-80% span <15 VERY COMPRESSED; 15..<30 COMPRESSED; 30..60 REASONABLY DISCRIMINATIVE; >60 VERY WIDE. Descriptive display convention, not validated football thresholds.
conventions.rawCompression: IQR after reliability stabilization / IQR before <0.50 means marked stabilization compression. With available like-for-like historical benchmark, current physical IQR / historical IQR <0.50 means raw signal compression relative to that benchmark. QB/coverage scalar proxies do not cover full multivariate formula. Cross-unit physical units are not directly comparable.
conventions.normalizationCompression: Middle-80 displayed span <30 with raw current/historical IQR >=0.50 suggests display compression (with marked stabilization compression, classify BOTH). A-D classification is conditional on available scalar evidence, not a scale redesign.
conventions.pathology: PASS: direction of score broadly aligns with non-formula observable facts, or discordance is explained by scope/prior/components. QUESTIONABLE: opposite score/benchmark quartiles or important construct ambiguity. CLEAR PATHOLOGY requires two genuinely independent facts on the same intended construct and unexplained opposite tails; this package cannot certify that with same-feed benchmarks alone.
conventions.discordance: Absolute displayed rank gap >=10 defines notable discordance; upper/lower quartile pair defines strong opposite-tail discordance. Cases selected systematically, not tuning targets.
conventions.alignment: Ingredient alignment separated from non-formula outcomes; same-feed non-formula benchmarks are not independent providers or ground truth.
conventions.historical: UNAVAILABLE for exact causal current-production unit predictive validation; no proxy replay represented as canonical validation

qbIndex.label: QB play
qbIndex.rawScope: QB all-play EPA proxy; complete vector also includes ANY/A, success, rushing and CPOE

receiverIndex.label: Receivers
receiverIndex.rawScope: WR/TE EPA/target after partial QB-environment subtraction

olIndex.label: Offensive line
olIndex.rawScope: PBP de-duplicated hit-or-sack disruption allowed/dropback; pass protection only

rbIndex.label: RB
rbIndex.rawScope: RB/FB 70% rushing EPA/carry + 30% partially residualized receiving EPA/target

coverageIndex.label: Coverage
coverageIndex.rawScope: Sack-free pass-attempt EPA allowed proxy; complete grade also uses CPOE allowed

runDefenseIndex.label: Run defense
runDefenseIndex.rawScope: Opponent rushing EPA/carry; includes QB runs in team outcomes

offenseComposite.label: Overall offense
offenseComposite.rawScope: Weighted already-normalized unit grades, not a physical raw signal

defenseIndex.label: Overall defense
defenseIndex.rawScope: Weighted already-normalized unit grades, not a physical raw signal

offenseIndex.label: Team efficiency (diagnostic)
offenseIndex.rawScope: Team EPA/play; compatibility/debug grade, not current offense-composite outcome key
